title: AnyList Grocery List Items Checked Leaderboard
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anylist:grocery items_checked=*
| stats sum(items_checked) as total_value, avg(items_checked) as avg_value by store_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks store values by total and average items checked across AnyList grocery list events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `items_checked` values for each AnyList grocery list event and review total and average items checked by store.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total items checked.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which store shows the biggest items checked numbers in your AnyList grocery list data.
